description: Static security scanner for ML model files — detects pickle bombs, Keras Lambda RCE and GGUF template injection, and generates CycloneDX / SPDX AI-BOMs (AIBOM) as EU AI Act, CRA and FDA §524B evidence.

written.description: Produces the compliance artefact as well as the verdict: a CycloneDX or SPDX bill of materials for a model file, alongside the Keras, GGUF and ONNX payloads it found while reading it.

alive.last_commit_message:
feat(action): fail-on-scan-error input; never report a stale SBOM (#139)

A scan that exits 1 (a missing directory, a parse error, an unreadable
model file such as a git-LFS pointer stub) used to end the Action job
green with nothing said. It now adds a warning annotation, and fails the
job with exit 1 when `fail-on-scan-error: true`. The default stays false
and becomes true at the next major release.

The Action now deletes its output file and the matching VEX files before
scanning, so a file left by an earlier step or committed to the repo is
never commented on or uploaded as this run's result.

Exit precedence is 2, then 1, then 3; the upload still runs first.
